item.subject: science
item.stem:
Ojas splits a chickpea seed and counts two cotyledons. The young plant later shows reticulate (netted) leaf veins and a taproot. A maize seed he opens has one cotyledon. In class he learns that two cotyledons mark a dicotyledon and one marks a monocotyledon, and that dicotyledons have reticulate venation with a taproot while monocotyledons have parallel venation with a fibrous root system.

Which claim correctly connects the chickpea?

options.A: The chickpea is a dicotyledon with reticulate venation and a taproot system.
options.B: The chickpea is a dicotyledon with parallel venation and a taproot system.
options.C: The maize is a dicotyledon with reticulate venation and a taproot system.
options.D: The chickpea is a monocotyledon with parallel venation and a fibrous root system.
